records.title: feat(analysis): partial diff-scope analysis with disclosed limited run state
records.release_claim: oversized but bounded diffs yield deterministic partial evidence without being represented as complete
records.reason: The old candidate explicitly deferred this behavior; current gate, badge, LSP, and recovery semantics depend on its typed scope identity.
records.non_claim: Partial evidence is not repository-wide authority and is gate-ineligible.

records.title: fix(analysis): attribute summary changed-file counts per language
records.release_claim: language-scoped summary counts describe the files each adapter actually considered
records.reason: Cross-language honesty is part of the release narrative; aggregate counts must not be projected as per-language coverage.
records.non_claim: Correct counts do not imply parity among language adapters.

records.title: perf(cli): reuse check artifacts across check, explain, and context
records.release_claim: expensive repeated CLI projections can reuse one exact, fail-closed analysis artifact
records.reason: Operationally useful and contract-bearing, but not essential to the minimum 0.11 trust narrative if fully deferred with matching docs.
records.non_claim: The artifact is not an implicit cache and does not cover every repository edit.

records.title: ux(analysis): disclose when diff contains only non-source files
records.release_claim: a zero-finding docs/config-only run explains why no source was analyzed
records.reason: Honest UX but not a schema or semantic dependency; deferral requires matching known-limit copy.
records.non_claim: Exit zero does not claim source analysis occurred.

records.title: perf(analysis): parallelize index-build parsing with rayon
records.release_claim: cold parsing is materially faster while preserving ordered semantic output
records.reason: The change is output-preserving but adds a dependency and may be needed for the documented editor latency boundary.
records.non_claim: Performance evidence does not alter analysis completeness or correctness.
